description: This Java class 'BulkWriteResultAckFlow' handles processing of bulk write results, sending acknowledgements or failure responses to an actor shard based on MongoDB bulk write outcomes, including error handling, consistency checks, and logging.

classes.name: BulkWriteResultAckFlow
classes.description: Handles processing of MongoDB bulk write results, sending acknowledgements or failure responses via Akka actor shard, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BulkWriteResultAckFlow with specified updater shard.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates an Akka Flow that processes WriteResultAndErrors objects and outputs log strings.

methods.name: checkBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Analyzes bulk write results, determines success or failure, logs results, and triggers acknowledgements.

methods.name: acknowledgeFailures
methods.description: Increments error counter and sends failure responses for given metadata items.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends acknowledgement or failure responses for a list of metadata items using a response creator function.

methods.name: createFailureResponse
methods.description: Creates a failure response for given metadata.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs an UpdateThingResponse with success or failure status.

methods.name: wasNotAcknowledged
methods.description: Checks if the bulk write result was not acknowledged.

methods.name: checkForConsistencyError
methods.description: Verifies if bulk write errors are within expected bounds, indicating data consistency.

methods.name: areAllIndexesWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks if all bulk write error indexes are within the range of requested write models.

methods.name: getAllThings
methods.description: Extracts all Metadata objects from WriteResultAndErrors.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Generates a log string summarizing the bulk write operation outcome, including errors and exceptions.
